# bulsu.tools

> Org landing site for bulsutools (https://github.com/bulsutools), a group of Bulacan State University students who build free, open-source tools for campus life. Not an official BulSU site. All tools are MIT licensed and run without accounts or tracking.

## Tools

- [Geary](https://geary.bulsu.tools): the student-managed handbook for BulSU. Guides on enrollment, academics, documents, and campus life. Source: https://github.com/bulsutools/geary
- [GWA Calculator](https://gwa-calculator.bulsu.tools): general weighted average and honors estimator. Runs entirely in the browser; grades are never uploaded. Source: https://github.com/bulsutools/gwa-calculator
- [Room TBA](https://room-tba.bulsu.tools): interactive map of the BulSU Malolos campuses (Campus 1 and Campus 2) with building search and room lookup. Forked from uplbtools/room-tba. Source: https://github.com/bulsutools/room-tba
